verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented bulk-operation capability, such as acting on many pods or volumes in one command or API call. `lium clusters up --nodes N` provisions one cluster resource for a single distributed job. The public nodes feed is a read-only listing, not a bulk action. Neither counts as performing operations across many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
